local function v79(p10)
    if not p10 then
        return "Unknown", 0, "Common"
    end

    local v218 = p10:match("%[([%d%.,]+)%s*[Kk][Gg]%]")
    local n7 = 0

    if v218 then
        n7 = tonumber((v218:gsub(",", ""))) or 0
    end

    local v220 = p10:gsub("<[^>]+>", ""):gsub("%[[^%]]+%]%s*", ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "Unknown"
    local v221 = v220:lower():gsub("%s+", "")

    return v220, n7, t2.value38[v221] or "Common"
end

end

local function v86(_, p15, p16)
    local elapsed = os.clock()
    local n8 = 0.7
    local v233 = "Building " .. p15 .. " tab..."

    pcall(function()
        t2.value2:Create(t2.value13, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(n8, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
		}):Play()

        if v233 then
            t2.value15.Text = v233
        end
    end)

    local ok3, result3 = xpcall(p16, function(err)
        local _debug = debug

        if _debug then
            _debug = debug.traceback
        end

        if _debug then
            return debug.traceback(tostring(err), 2)
        end

        return tostring(err)
    end)

    if not ok3 then
        warn(string.format("[RoxyHub %s Error]: %s", p15, (tostring(result3))))
    else
        print(string.format("[RoxyHub] %s tab built in %.2fs", p15, os.clock() - elapsed))
    end

    task.wait()
end

        end
    end
	})
    local v316 = t2.value48:Section({
		Title = "Profiles & AutoLoad",
		Opened = true
	})
    if makefolder and not isfolder("RoxyHub_BreakAndStealAnEgg/configs") then
        pcall(function()
            if not isfolder("RoxyHub_BreakAndStealAnEgg") then
                makefolder("RoxyHub_BreakAndStealAnEgg")
            end

            makefolder("RoxyHub_BreakAndStealAnEgg/configs")
        end)
    end
    local function v317()
        local t14 = {}

                                    BatHitRequest:FireServer(v428.Character)
                                    task.wait(0.1)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if t2.value18.TargetGuards then
                        local _ipairs = ipairs
                        for _, v432 in _ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                            local v433 = v432:IsA("Model")

                            if v433 then
                                v433 = v432.Name:find("Guard")

                                if v433 then
                                    v433 = v432:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                end
                            end

                            if v433 then
                                _ipairs = (v432.HumanoidRootPart.Position - v424.Position).Magnitude

                                if _ipairs <= t2.value18.BatRange then
                                    t2.value32()
                                    BatHitRequest:FireServer(v432)
                                    task.wait(0.1)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        task.wait(0.3)
    end
end)

    while true do
        if t2.value18.RareNotifier then
            local BreakableEgg = t2.value8:GetTagged("BreakableEgg")
            local _ipairs = ipairs

            for _, v437 in _ipairs(BreakableEgg) do
                if v437:IsA("BasePart") and not t2.value53[v437] then
                    local v438 = v437:GetAttribute("WeightBracket") or ""
                    local v439 = v437:GetAttribute("EggType") or ""
                    local v440 = v438 == "TITANIC"

                    if not v440 then
                        v440 = v438 == "HUGE"

                        if not v440 then
                            v440 = v439:find("Cosmic")

                            if not v440 then
                                v440 = v439:find("Secret") or v439:find("Fortune")
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if v440 then
                        t2.value53[v437] = true
                        _ipairs = t2.value20

                        local format = string.format
                        local v442 = v438 ~= "" and v438

                        if not v442 then
                            v442 = "RARE"
                        end

                        local v443 = format("[%s] %s spawned!", v442, v439)

                        _ipairs:Notify({
							Title = "Rare Egg Detected!",
							Content = v443,
							Duration = 5,
							Icon = "bell"
						})
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        task.wait(2)
    end
end)
t2.value11(t2.value4.Stepped:Connect(function()
    local Noclip = t2.value18.Noclip

    if Noclip then
        Noclip = t2.value10.Character
    end

    if Noclip then
        for _, descendant in ipairs(t2.value10.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.CanCollide then
                descendant.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end

    local Character = t2.value10.Character
    local v448 = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if v448 then
        local WalkSpeed = t2.value18.WalkSpeed

        if WalkSpeed then
            WalkSpeed = v448.WalkSpeed ~= t2.value18.WalkSpeed
        end

        if WalkSpeed then
            v448.WalkSpeed = t2.value18.WalkSpeed
        end

        local JumpPower = t2.value18.JumpPower

        if JumpPower then
            JumpPower = v448.JumpPower ~= t2.value18.JumpPower
        end

        if JumpPower then
            v448.UseJumpPower = true
            v448.JumpPower = t2.value18.JumpPower
        end
    end
end))
t2.value11(t2.value5.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if t2.value18.InfiniteJump then
        local Character = t2.value10.Character
        local v452 = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if v452 then
            v452:ChangeState("Jumping")
        end
    end
end))
t2.value54 = nil
t2.value55 = nil
t2.value11(t2.value4.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local v453 = t2.value24()
    local v454 = v77()
    local Fly = t2.value18.Fly

    if Fly then
        Fly = v453 and v454
    end

    if Fly then
        if not t2.value54 then
            t2.value54 = Instance.new("BodyPosition")
            t2.value54.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1000000, 1000000, 1000000)
            t2.value54.Position = v453.Position
            t2.value54.Parent = v453
            t2.value55 = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
            t2.value55.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1000000, 1000000, 1000000)
            t2.value55.CFrame = v453.CFrame
            t2.value55.Parent = v453
        end

        local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local zero = Vector3.zero

        if t2.value5:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            zero += CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
        end

        if t2.value5:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            zero -= CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
        end

        if t2.value5:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            zero -= CurrentCamera.CFrame.RightVector
        end

        if t2.value5:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            zero += CurrentCamera.CFrame.RightVector
        end

        if t2.value5:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            zero += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end

        if t2.value5:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
            zero -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end

        if zero.Magnitude > 0 then
            zero = zero.Unit * t2.value18.FlySpeed
        end

        t2.value54.Position = v453.Position + zero * 0.05
        t2.value55.CFrame = CurrentCamera.CFrame

        return
    end

    if t2.value54 then
        t2.value54:Destroy()
    end

    if t2.value55 then
        t2.value55:Destroy()
    end
end))
task.wait()
